reason: Both cover the same facets (testis determination/gonad development, Mullerian-derivative organogenesis, activin/TGF-beta-SMAD signalling, gonadotropin/folliculogenesis, broad gametogenesis), but B does so with far fewer near-duplicate gonad-development and germ-cell variants and drops A's off-target lung/branching-organ theme (A28).

B keeps the core contexts (CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte trafficking, inflammatory chemokine response, endothelial adhesion/extravasation brakes, chemokine-receptor signalling) without A's many overlapping re-combinations of the same monocyte-chemotaxis module and its weakly related stromal/fibroblast theme.

A gives a clean nested ladder from the non-oxidative PPP core through pentose/xylulose, galactose, fructose, sugar transport and glycolysis/glycogen, whereas B repeats the same sugar-interconversion contexts in some 20 overlapping themes and only adds PRPP synthesis as a stray member rather than a clear nucleotide-synthesis context.

B captures the same facets (dystroglycan O-mannosylation/dystroglycanopathy core, muscle-basement membrane-DGC context, GAG/proteoglycan and broader glycosylation disorders) with one well-merged muscle/laminin/DGC theme and fewer redundant glycosylation super-sets than A.

A covers the same facets (ERAD/ER quality control, ER targeting and insertion, COPII export, UPR, whole secretory pathway) in 10 themes, while B adds mostly near-duplicate ERAD and ER-targeting variants (B4/B5/B7, B9-B11, B12/B13) for little new context.

B includes the vascular eNOS/NO-cGMP and NADPH-oxidase contexts (B11, B17) that are central to superoxide control of nitric-oxide signalling and absent from A, outweighing B's extra redundancy among its iron/heme themes, a clutter A also shows.
